G0.exit: Deterministic environment, branch protection contract, task ledger and baseline results exist.

G0.failure: Freeze implementation task dispatch and repair baseline reproducibility.

G1.name: Shared delivery and contract foundation
G1.entry: G0 is green and approved contracts are hash-pinned.
G1.exit: Canonical types, GCS, leases, errors, evidence envelopes, generated-boundary rules and contract tests are green.
G1.rollback: Revert contract implementation while retaining compatibility adapters and stored-version readers.

G1.prohibited: No backend selection or runtime verification from schema validation.

G2.name: Risk retirement
G2.entry: G1 contracts are fixed and disposable environments are available.
G2.exit: All critical spikes have reproducible evidence and an explicit retain/harden/discard disposition.
G2.rollback: Destroy disposable spike environments; retain only manifests and decision inputs.
G2.failure: Create a blocking governance decision; do not silently substitute technology.
G2.authority: Architecture Review Authority for architecture-affecting outcomes
G2.prohibited: Spike success is not final implementation evidence or PoC conformance.

G3.name: First governed vertical slice
G3.entry: Relevant G2 risks are resolved and qualifying services are pinned.
G3.exit: One synthetic thread traverses real C1-C8 boundaries with fail-closed controls and reproducible receipts.
G3.rollback: Revert the slice release and restore the pre-slice schema snapshot.
G3.failure: Return failing boundary to its owning workstream; no partial mission-thread claim.
G3.authority: Integration Agent and Independent Conformance Reviewer
G3.prohibited: No E1 or PoC-GO; a thin slice does not cover the 285-requirement universe.

G4.name: Progressive C1-C8 expansion
G4.entry: G3 thread is repeatable and compatibility boundaries are explicit.
G4.exit: C1-C8 responsibilities, the 44-transition FSM and security/operations integrations meet task-level oracles.
G4.rollback: Rollback per component release and replay from the last compatible canonical checkpoint.
G4.failure: Quarantine the component increment; keep prior compatible slice active.
G4.authority: Delivery Coordinator after independent task review
G4.prohibited: No global Verified state before qualifying campaigns.

G5.name: Full Governed Agent Memory
G5.entry: C3, C4, C6, C8 and security controls required by memory are green.
G5.exit: All kinds, scopes and lifecycle semantics are implemented; preparatory tests are green.
G5.rollback: Disable new memory admissions, preserve immutable versions/tombstones and restore prior readers.
G5.failure: Full-memory runtime remains NO-GO; no kind or scope may be deferred.
G5.authority: Governed Memory Lead plus Security Reviewer
G5.prohibited: No full-memory claim until FGM-01–FGM-20 qualify at G6.

G6.name: Runtime conformance campaign
G6.entry: G4 and G5 are green; environments and fixtures are content-addressed.
G6.exit: BA-01–BA-08, FGM-01–FGM-20, 44 FSM transitions and mission thread all have qualifying non-skipped results.
G6.rollback: Invalidate the campaign manifest and preserve raw results for diagnosis.
G6.failure: Any failed/unavailable mandatory case keeps PoC runtime NO-GO.
G6.prohibited: No skipped/mock result counts as PASS; no Production readiness claim.

G7.name: PoC-GO decision package
G7.entry: G6 qualifying evidence is complete and traceable to all P0/PoC requirements.
G7.exit: A governed decision package states results, limitations, residual risks and exact evidence scope.
G7.rollback: Withdraw the candidate decision package; do not rewrite evidence or decisions.
G7.failure: Remain PoC NO-GO and issue scoped remediation tasks.
G7.authority: Product Owner and Architecture Review Authority under recorded governance
G7.prohibited: PoC-GO cannot imply Production readiness, E2, scale, HA or multi-region qualification.
